title.narrative: OVOF - Use of Art, Media, and Culture-Lebanon

description.narrative: OVOF has seen the results of working with artists, media and cultural workers. It helps shiftmental models around gender and sexuality, and disrupts stigma steeped in bias andprejudice. OVOF partners have (effectively) used art and arts-based public campaigns (forexample, film festivals) to change the way people think about highly stigmatised topics suchas sex work, both within feminist movements and in society. Art has the power to reachpeople beyond activist circles and across country borders. Shifting social norms aroundgender and sexuality (both within and outside movements) is critical to OVOF and its workwith artists.

comment.narrative: APC took time to identify interventions that will be beneficial for structurally silenced women and CSOs. As the indicator measures any new values occurring since the start of the intervention,the baseline value is set at 0.
Due to longer time than expected going into identifying new partner in Lebanon, we will not be doing any activity in Lebanon this year.
APC does not have actuals for this period due to having no targets for Lebanon for this period.

APC aims to do 1 intervention in Lebanon to build capacity around the use of art, media, and culture by using digital technologies to visibilise alternative narratives of structurally silenced women and their communities.

Different kinds of activities related to arts, media, and culture were implemented by the partners. This includes digital storytelling workshops, filmmaking sessions, creating zines and skill building sessions on feminist technology. Creative ways to talk about structurally silenced women and communities and their rights and tell their stories was very popular
